networks.name: spec_helper
networks.description: Answers questions about the Worldwide Agentic Web MVP spec (profile 0.2) and drafts the files an open agentic website must publish.
sample_queries: How does a site load another site's network as a peer?
Draft a minimal agent-manifest.json and links.json for a network named trail_guide.
Which requirement says my API key must never reach a peer site?
Check my live website for me.

peer_policy.note: spec_helper calls no other sites. Callers run it with their own router and key.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
